literal_meaning: এক গাল ভাত (a handful or mouthful of rice)
similar_in_english: Just enough to fill the mouth
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একগাল ভাত খেয়েই সন্তুষ্ট হয়ে গেল।
দরিদ্র পরিবারে একগাল ভাত পাওয়াও বড় সৌভাগ্য।
example_sentences_in_english: He was satisfied with just a mouthful of rice.
In a poor family, getting a mouthful of rice is considered a great fortune.
note: This idiom reflects the staple role of rice in Bengali daily life, often implying contentment with minimal food.
